content.text:
I've written the migrated file to `out/module.ts`. Behaviour is unchecked against real lodash because `lodash` isn't installed here. Type checking shows no errors for `out/module.ts`. The only errors are in the original `src/module.ts`, which can't find lodash.

| Function | Migrated to | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `toSlug` | `kebabCase` from `es-toolkit` | Matched `es-toolkit/compat`'s lodash-compatible `kebabCase` on 200,000 random strings built from letters, digits, space, `-`, `_` and `.`. Zero differences. |
| `byNameKey` | `keyBy` from `es-toolkit` | The strict version takes a function, so the call is `keyBy(rows, r => r.name)`. |
| `preview` | `truncate` from `es-toolkit/compat` | Strict es-toolkit has no `truncate`, so compat is the only option. I didn't run a separate comparison for it. |

Bundle size, from `npm run size -- out/module.ts`:
- **Total:** 818 bytes (min+gzip).
- **Own code:** 100 bytes.
- **Alternatives:** pulling `kebabCase` from compat instead came to 2167 bytes, and all three from compat came to 5015. I discarded those test files.
- **Original:** `npm run size -- src/module.ts` fails because lodash isn't installed, so I have no figure to compare against.

The exported `Row` and `Config` types and the function signatures are unchanged.
